summary.en: Chinese-developed desktop client for multiple LLM providers, with a win-arm64 setup on GitHub releases.
summary.zh-TW: 中國開發的多模型 LLM 桌面用戶端，GitHub 發行版提供 win-arm64 安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
